return all vectors with distance < radius. Note that many indexes do not implement the range_search (only the k-NN search is mandatory). The distances are converted to float to reuse the RangeSearchResult structure, but they are integer. By convention, only distances < radius (strict comparison) are returned, ie. radius = 0 does not return any result and 1 returns only exact same vectors.

detaileddescription.para: Exhaustive Hamming search over GPU-resident binary vectors. Every positive dimension divisible by 8 is supported. GPU search is exact for k <= 512, with ties ordered by increasing label. Larger k, selectors, and counts exceeding uint32_t use the CPU copy. GPU failures throw rather than silently falling back. Range search and remove_ids are not supported. As with other Metal indexes, callers must serialize mutation and search.
